meterGeometry.description: How light was gathered for a reading. Incident measures light falling on the subject (dome integrates 3D form; flat disc measures a plane); reflected measures light returning from the scene, either wide-field or through spot optics.

lightKind.description: The temporal character of the measured light.

priorityMode.description: Which exposure variable the meter solved for: aperture priority solves shutter, shutter priority solves aperture, iso priority holds time and aperture and solves sensitivity; ev reports EV only.

flashSyncMode.description: How a flash measurement was triggered/integrated.

readingRole.description: Role of this reading within a multi-reading workflow (spot memory sets, averaging, contrast evaluation). 'single' is a standalone reading; members of a set share a seriesId.

sensorPath.description: For camera-based (phone) meters: which measurement path produced the value. 'ae-metadata' derives EV from the camera's auto-exposure state; 'raw-patch' integrates linear RAW pixels over the spot patch; 'processed-patch' estimates from tone-mapped frames; 'dedicated-cell' is a hardware photocell (handheld meters).

cameraModule.description: Phone camera module used for a camera-based reading.

calibrationReference.description: What a calibration profile was derived against.
